content.text: # plugin\_management.get\_plugin\_dependencies
[Programs](<hypertui://programs/>)
Resolve the canonical public plugins
declared by one plugin's app manifest.
Use only when a skill or user explicitly
asks for dependency metadata. Pass a
plugin ID or name@marketplace
reference unchanged. Named references
resolve by globally listed plugin name.
This reports metadata plus current
user-aware plugin status, installation
policy, and installed state; it does not
install or connect anything. The result
separates visible canonical plugins from
app entries that lack a unique canonical
plugin or whose canonical plugin is
unavailable to the current user.
